title: Treasury yields fall from multiyear highs
summary: The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield hit 5.613%—its highest since 2002—before retreating 2 bps. The 10-year yield reached 5.243%, a level last seen in April 2002, before easing 5 bps. A stronger dollar and sticky inflation expectations drove the spike; markets await Friday's jobs report for the next catalyst.
why: 30年期美债收益率触24年高位，长端利率上行直接压制科技成长股估值（英伟达、谷歌等持仓估值再定价）；高利率环境亦提升sell put期权策略的权利金水平，但同时加大行权风险。今日（10月2日）港股国庆后重开，沪深港通暂停至10月8日，外资参与受限，港股可能独立震荡。

title: The September jobs report will be released Friday. Here's what to expect
summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics releases September nonfarm payrolls at 8:30 a.m. ET Friday (Oct 2). Wall Street expects 84,000 new jobs with unemployment at 4.1%. ADP's private-sector count of 90,000 beat the 68,000 forecast, lifting expectations. Fed funds futures show a ~72% probability the Federal Reserve holds rates unchanged at the October 28 meeting (per October 1 data).
why: 非农若超预期将进一步压低10月28日加息预期，利好科技成长板块；若大幅不及预期则引发衰退担忧，波动率上升有利于期权权利金策略收益，但同时加大持股下行风险。

title: China's Manufacturing Activity Returns to Expansion
summary: China's official NBS Manufacturing PMI rose to 50.1 in September 2026, the first expansion since June, up from 49.8 in August. The output sub-index hit a nine-month high of 51.7. New orders continued to grow (50.5) while employment remained weak (48.4). High-tech, equipment and consumer goods manufacturing all expanded.
why: 制造业PMI重返荣枯线上方，为港股国庆后重开（10月2日）提供正面宏观背景，利好腾讯、阿里巴巴、美团等港股持仓；但沪深港通暂停至10月8日，资金面受限，初期反弹幅度或不及预期。

title: Gold holds steady with U.S. jobs data on radar
summary: Spot gold steadied around $4,155 per ounce on October 1, after falling more than 6% in September—the worst monthly decline of 2026. Elevated U.S. Treasury yields and a stronger dollar have compressed gold's appeal, as the metal offers no yield. Markets await Friday's non-farm payrolls report for Fed policy direction.
why: 金价9月月跌逾6%、较年初高点约$5,608已累计回落约26%，对老铺黄金(6181.HK)的营收和利润率构成持续压制；非农数据若强劲将强化高利率预期，金价可能继续承压，需重新评估老铺黄金中期持仓逻辑。

title: S&P 500 closes higher to start October as Treasury yields retreat from multiyear highs
summary: U.S. equities ended September higher on the final trading day, offering a brief reprieve after the S&P 500's worst monthly performance since June—389 of its 500 stocks closed lower for the month. Yields retreated slightly from 24-year highs. October historically delivers an average 0.7% S&P 500 gain, though it is the most volatile month of the second half of the year.
why: 9月是今年最差月份，美股整体承压；但10月历史季节性偏多，市场进入关键事件窗口（10月2日非农、10月15日前后财报季开启、10月28日美联储会议），波动率可能维持高位，有利于sell put策略收取较高权利金。

title: Bitcoin bulls just had a monster quarter. So did crypto hackers
summary: Bitcoin rose 42.7% in Q3 2026, its best quarterly performance since Q1 2024, with BTC around $84,800 on October 1. Meanwhile crypto security incidents resulted in $1.26 billion in losses in Q3, with September alone accounting for $768.5 million—the worst month of 2026 for crypto hacks.
why: 比特币Q3强劲上涨带动链上活跃度提升，利好Circle(CRCL)的USDC使用量和稳定币赛道整体估值；Q3加密安全事故频发进一步凸显Circle合规型稳定币的竞争护城河，监管友好的USDC在机构端吸引力增强。

title: Google Gemini 4 arrives as Wall Street shifts to personal agents
summary: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon on October 1, its most advanced AI model, targeting coding, cybersecurity, and enterprise tasks. Argon achieved 77.9% on the DeepSWE coding benchmark (a record result) and matches OpenAI in cybersecurity. Priced at $2/M input tokens and $10/M output tokens. Alphabet shares fell as investors signaled demand for a breakthrough personal AI agent rather than another foundation model.
why: 发布后GOOGL股价下跌表明市场预期已高、模型本身难以催化新一轮上涨；华尔街焦点转向AI个人助手/Agent领域，谷歌尚未推出杀手级产品；但Gemini 4强化了企业端AI能力，Google Cloud长期受益；短期可关注IV是否在发布事件后压缩以影响期权策略。

title: Micron stock barely budged on chipmaker's latest earnings. Wall Street still thinks gains will come
summary: Micron shares were flat in premarket trading after crushing Q4 FY2026 estimates (revenue $54.23B vs $51.07B expected; EPS $33.42 vs $31.61), with the stock up 273% year to date—reflecting heavily priced-in expectations. Analysts remain bullish on continued HBM demand and the Q1 FY2027 guidance of ~$61.5B revenue. Intel, another chip sector peer, has surged more than sixfold and trades near all-time highs.
why: 业绩超预期但股价不涨，说明HBM超级周期预期已充分定价；对SK海力士CSOP ETF持仓而言HBM需求基本面仍强劲，但若后续数据不再超预期则估值扩张空间收窄。注意业绩后IV压缩可能影响持仓期权策略的时间价值。
